thread:
maya: Quick plan: running a webinar + benchmark workshop next Tue. Goal: finalize launch messaging and inbound routing so SDRs can separate demo vs deep-technical requests. Agenda: benchmark story, claim pruning, routing rules, SDR scripts. Who can join?

jon: I can lead routing rules and SLA mapping. Propose two paths: demo -> AE list, deep -> SE rotation. Keep it simple.

eli: Two paths makes sense. Need tight benchmark framing: 'serving-first economics' vs cloud-managed endpoints. Send conservative numbers.

sara: I'll draft invite copy and two CTAs: "Request a demo" and "Book a technical deep-dive". Will also prepare three subject lines for an A/B test.

alex: SDRs want one-sentence outreach. Drop two one-liners please.

maya: One-liners: demo = "Thanks for registering — want a 15m demo of predictable latency?" deep = "We ran long-context benchmarks — want a technical deep-dive with infra leads?"

jon: Routing detail: add an intent field on sign-up: intent=demo or intent=deep. Map via webhook to CRM lists. Sample rule to test: intent=demo -> ae-demo-list, sla_hours=24; intent=deep -> se-rotation, sla_hours=48. Keep minimal.

eli: If SE capacity is limited, fallback to a technical follow-up queue that sends the recording + scheduling link. Keeps momentum.

maya: Ops-bot, create Calendly and rehearsal event and paste links here.

ops-bot: Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/webinar-bench. Rehearsal: Mon 11am PT.

jon: For slides keep two conservative soundbites: "<2x latency vs default managed endpoints at 1k tokens" and "~35% lower per-token cost with prefix caching + continuous batching". Research to validate.

sara: Subject lines for split test: A) "Webinar: serving-first benchmarks that cut cost" B) "How to make LLM inference predictable at scale" C) "Benchmarked: cost & latency tradeoffs for production LLMs". I'll run sample sends and report.

maya: Action items: jon - routing webhook + example JSON; alex - 2-line SDR scripts and inbox templates; sara - invite copy + subject tests; eli - validate soundbites; maya - run claim pruning. Drop any slide one-liners by EOD Fri.

alex: I'll seed outreach to 12 target accounts with the demo script after rehearsal.

jon: I'll draft a 5-bullet FAQ for sales on routing expectations and post it before the workshop.

maya: Thanks everyone — this should tighten the launch funnel and reduce dropped deep-dive requests. :thumbsup:
